description: Joins MP3 files end to end, frame by frame with no re-encoding, so nothing is lost. The files must share a sample rate and be all mono or all stereo; mixing formats (WAV, M4A) or adding pauses needs the web page (https://helpyself.com/merge-mp3/). Can you run shell commands? Then do not send base64: upload the file from disk with curl -F file=@<path> https://helpyself.com/api/v1/tools/merge-mp3 (same tool, same answer, much faster). A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

files.description: The MP3 files to join, in the order they should play. At least two. They must share a sample rate and be all mono or all stereo; the result is joined frame by frame, with no re-encoding, so nothing is lost.

items.description: One MP3 to include, in full.

data.description: This MP3's bytes, base64-encoded. A data: URL prefix is stripped. Send the whole file as it is, up to 20 MB: do not crop, shrink or split it first. If you can run shell commands, do not write the base64 out yourself: send the file from disk with curl -F file=@<path> -F <option>=<value> https://helpyself.com/api/v1/tools/merge-mp3 (add -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" if you have one); the answer is the same JSON.

name.description: Filename, used to name this file in the response and in any error about it.

name: merge_mp3
title: Merge MP3
